answer: The knoll holds work receipts rather than names, so the pigment of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the copper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
